event_records.description: The Nobel Assembly is in the final phase of deliberations for the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. The decision is scheduled to be announced on October 5, 2026.

nobel_assembly_at_karolinska_institutet.name: Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet
nobel_assembly_at_karolinska_institutet.persona_brief:
You are Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet.
The Nobel Assembly is the body that selects the laureate(s) for the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. They have their own internal procedures, criteria, and deliberations. They are aware of the nominations received for the 2026 prize and have been evaluating candidates. They have not yet made a final decision.

resolution.question: Will the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine be awarded to a woman in 2026?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the official announcement on 2026-10-05 includes at least one woman among the laureates for the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Otherwise resolve NO.
